name: Bot Callsigns - Reloaded
teaser: Getting tired of the same bot names you meet? Well.. This mod adds 32,651 of them. Including original names from SPT!
description_html:
Nothing could hurt you in post death screen if you’re already dead.. Right? How about head-eyes from GIGA_CHAD_69 or IHaveKappaLBozo? Maybe find a dead PMC with a dogtag BSG_FIX_UR_GAME?

This mod adds 32,651 unique names into the game for BEAR and USEC individually which would show in your game, dogtags and flea. This mod also includes OG names that come with SPT!

More examples:
CheekyStepScav
WiggleIfFriendl
u_play_like_bot
PlsNoHeadEyes
IDontLikeTarkov
epic_fail

Contribution

You can contribute and suggest your names by providing a list in any format at GitHub provided on the mod page or simply DM me on the **SPT HUB.

Installation

Drag and drop the contents of the 7z archive in your SPT folder.

PLEASE NOTE THAT I AM NOT THE ORIGINAL AUTHOR OF THIS MOD. ALL CREDITS GOES TO HELLDIVER - THE ORIGINAL CREATOR OF THIS MOD.
